description:
# Check-completion gate for epic opi-q5k

Close this ticket when every per-file check ticket under epic opi-q5k has been processed (closed). Each check ticket either (a) confirms our Elixir tests already match upstream, or (b) spawned a compliance ticket that blocks the acceptance gate.

This gate does NOT wait for compliance tickets to be resolved — only for the checks themselves to be done.

# How to verify

- \`bw list --parent opi-q5k --all\` — every check ticket (titled "Check: upstream <file>") is closed.
- The acceptance gate remains blocked by any open compliance tickets.

# On close

Acceptance gate (see its blocked-by list) becomes eligible once no other blockers remain.
title: Check-completion gate: all per-file check tickets processed
